stories.title: KPMG settles Silicon Valley Bank class-action lawsuit
stories.summary: KPMG has agreed to a $224.5 million settlement in a class-action lawsuit following the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank. The firm, which audited the bank since 1994, issued unqualified opinions until 14 days before the bank failed. The agreement does not constitute an admission of wrongdoing.

stories.title: GPTZero identifies inaccuracies in Accenture research
stories.summary: GPTZero reported 31 inaccuracies across three papers linked to Accenture, including 15 in a single study on African development. Accenture attributed the issues to human error and stated the report is being corrected for republication. The firm denied that artificial intelligence caused the errors.

stories.title: McKinsey advises cybersecurity overhaul for AI threats
stories.summary: McKinsey reports that artificial intelligence is accelerating the exploitation of software vulnerabilities, with the window between disclosure and attack narrowing to hours. The firm recommends higher investments in automated threat detection and continuous monitoring to address the increased speed of modern cyberattacks.

stories.title: Vodafone Idea and PwC launch AI laboratory
stories.summary: Vodafone Idea has launched Vi Intelligence, a strategic initiative for AI-led transformation. The centerpiece is a laboratory built with PwC India to develop and scale enterprise AI solutions. The company says the lab will coordinate work across digital infrastructure and consultancy services.

stories.title: Accenture faces Court of Appeal in disability case
stories.summary: Accenture is appealing an Employment Appeal Tribunal decision regarding unfair dismissal and disability discrimination. The case involves a former employee and concerns how firms assess capability under an up or out promotion model. The hearing is scheduled for 10 and 11 November 2026.

stories.title: Accenture out of running for Aldi global account
stories.summary: Aldi has narrowed its global agency shortlist to Omnicom, Publicis, and WPP, excluding Accenture and Havas from the competition for the 700 million pound account. The German retailer operates more than 13,600 stores across 18 countries and is currently reviewing its creative and media partnerships.

stories.title: KPMG Australia government contract ban extended
stories.summary: The Australian government has extended a ban on KPMG Australia from new Commonwealth contracts until 28 February 2027. An independent review identified serious weaknesses in the firm’s ethical culture and handling of confidential client information. The firm remains excluded from new government work.

stories.title: McKinsey report suggests AI can capture CEO expertise
stories.summary: A new McKinsey report suggests artificial intelligence can convert the decision-making experience of chief executives into a shared organisational resource. The firm claims this approach could improve efficiency and reduce dependence on individual leaders. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: EY projects India semiconductor market growth
stories.summary: An EY-IESA report projects India’s semiconductor market will grow from 64 billion dollars in 2026 to 200 billion dollars by 2035. The report suggests this growth presents an opportunity to convert domestic demand into manufacturing and supply-chain resilience. Consumer electronics currently account for 30 percent of the market.

stories.title: McKinsey estimates climate adaptation costs
stories.summary: McKinsey estimates that annual climate adaptation costs could reach 1.2 trillion dollars by 2050 under a 2 degree Celsius warming scenario. The report identifies 20 measures to protect infrastructure from extreme weather, noting that current investment levels remain significantly lower than projected needs.

stories.title: AI adoption in Indian hospitals faces cost questions
stories.summary: Indian hospitals are increasingly using artificial intelligence for administrative tasks, scan prioritisation, and medical image analysis. While these tools aim to improve efficiency, industry experts note that the impact on overall treatment costs remains unproven due to ongoing expenses for training, integration, and usage fees.

stories.title: FICCI-EY paper calls for PM2.5 air pollution targets
stories.summary: A joint paper from FICCI and EY urges the implementation of clear PM2.5 targets to address air pollution in India. The report notes that air pollution was linked to two million deaths in 2023 and advocates for clean air to be central to the national healthcare agenda.

stories.title: Consumers remain wary of AI wellness advice
stories.summary: More than half of consumers use AI for wellness, yet 40% of US users worry the advice may be inaccurate, according to McKinsey. Reliance on friends, family, and healthcare practitioners still outweighs AI chatbots in shaping purchases. A quarter of consumers plan to avoid AI health tools entirely.

stories.title: Air pollution costs India nearly 10% of GDP
stories.summary: Air pollution costs India up to 9.5% of GDP annually due to productivity losses, healthcare costs, and premature deaths, according to a FICCI-EY report. The findings estimate annual business losses at $95 billion. The economic toll is calculated based on 2022 data.

stories.title: Biodiverse Consulting joins Ecology Group
stories.summary: Environmental consultancy Biodiverse Consulting has been acquired by Global Ecology and Environmental Group. The firm specializes in biodiversity net gain and nutrient neutrality. Founder Vicki Mordue said the move matches the firm's ambition, while Ecology Group chief executive Philip Smith noted the company has built a distinctive position.

stories.title: AWR Lloyd acquires automotive intelligence firm Auteneo
stories.summary: Strategy consultancy AWR Lloyd has acquired Auteneo, a boutique firm focused on Southeast Asian automotive market intelligence. Auteneo uses a proprietary generative AI platform to analyze online conversations among car buyers. The firm was founded by a former McKinsey advisor to track consumer preferences and electric mobility trends.

stories.title: Macnica acquires majority stake in Orangeleaf Consulting
stories.summary: Japanese technology group Macnica has acquired a majority stake in Orangeleaf Consulting. The firm provides digital transformation, agile development, and AI services across Malaysia, Japan, and Singapore. Founded in 2018, Orangeleaf supports clients through the complete technology journey, from initial strategy to internal capability building and continuous improvement.

stories.summary: French management consultancy Mews Partners has acquired manufacturing-focused firm OPEO. The deal adds 40 consultants to Mews Partners, which now employs 350 people across France and Germany. The firm reported 2026 revenue of €70 million and works with manufacturing companies across their entire value chains.

stories.title: EXL acquires AI consulting firm Aimpoint Digital
stories.summary: Data and AI services company EXL has acquired Aimpoint Digital to strengthen its enterprise platform engineering capabilities. The deal adds approximately 250 AI engineers and architects to the EXL workforce. Financial terms were not disclosed, and the acquisition follows EXL's recent purchase of AI training company iMerit.

stories.title: MNP acquires Schwartz & Company
stories.summary: National accounting and consulting firm MNP has agreed to acquire Scarborough-based Schwartz & Company. The boutique firm provides accounting and tax services to small- and medium-sized businesses in the Greater Toronto Area. Leaders Vince Chiofalo and Gus Yantsis will join MNP as partners when the deal closes.

stories.title: EisnerAmper acquires RSM Sage Intacct practice
stories.summary: EisnerAmper has acquired the Sage Intacct consulting practice from RSM US. The deal, expected to close in early 2027, adds more than 35 professionals to the firm. The team specializes in implementing and optimizing the Sage Intacct ERP platform for small- and mid-sized organizations.

stories.title: Foreign funds pour into India as regional markets struggle
stories.summary: Foreign investors bought $1.6 billion in Indian shares on November 5, the largest single-day inflow in nearly six years. The Sensex gained 2.6 percent, while Asian chip markets faced continued declines. The move suggests a rotation out of Seoul and Taipei, though the durability remains unproven.

stories.title: Vietnam digital economy targets $49 billion
stories.summary: Vietnam’s digital economy expects a gross merchandise value of $49 billion by 2026, according to the e-Conomy SEA 2026 report. E-commerce remains the largest contributor, accounting for two-thirds of the total. The sector aims to connect businesses with customers through increasingly pervasive digital platforms.

stories.title: EY and FICCI call for shipbuilding overhaul
stories.summary: India needs a predictable, long-term demand pipeline and improved financing to grow its shipbuilding sector, according to an EY and FICCI report. Despite a strategic location, the country’s global market share remains limited. India managed 418 vessel repairs in the last fiscal year across 42 dry docks.

stories.summary: As India celebrates its 80th Independence Day, the nation’s manufacturing sector stands as a pillar of self-reliance and progress. stories.title: Vietnam digital economy growth remains rapid
stories.summary: Vietnam’s digital economy is projected to reach $49 billion by 2026, a 20 percent year-on-year increase. The e-Conomy SEA report by Google, Temasek and Bain & Company identifies the country as one of Southeast Asia’s fastest-growing digital markets, driven by expanding platforms and shifting consumer habits.

stories.title: Report urges 11-fold increase in Indian shipbuilding
stories.summary: A FICCI-EY report calls for a coordinated expansion of India's shipbuilding industry to improve its global standing. The study identifies gaps in production capacity, financing and infrastructure. It recommends integrated industrial clusters and standardised vessel designs to help the country match competitors like Vietnam.

stories.title: Air pollution linked to two million deaths in 2023
stories.summary: Air pollution was linked to more than two million deaths in India in 2023, according to a FICCI-EY report. The study warns of severe respiratory and cardiovascular health impacts. It calls for year-round pollution control and stronger PM2.5 targets to address the ongoing public health crisis.

stories.title: Manappuram Finance CTO resigns
stories.summary: Manappuram Finance Group CTO Narayanan Easwaran has resigned, citing health issues caused by extensive travel requirements. Easwaran submitted his resignation in August and completed his three-month notice period on November 7. No successor has been announced by the company.

stories.title: CIMA+ launches program management office
stories.summary: Engineering consultancy CIMA+ has appointed Arsalan Zargar to lead its newly established program management office. The firm aims to strengthen its role in Canada’s infrastructure sector. Zargar will coordinate participation in major projects and guide the company’s strategic partnerships and program development.

stories.title: A11 Management Consulting joins CEO development initiative
stories.summary: A11 Management Consulting is partnering with the Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry on a new executive programme. The initiative aims to equip local leaders with management capabilities for digital transformation and green transitions. The programme seeks to improve the international competitiveness of Vietnamese business leaders.

stories.title: Voltas appoints Deloitte as statutory auditors for five years
stories.summary: Voltas has appointed Deloitte Haskins and Sells as statutory auditors for a five-year term covering financial years 2028 to 2032. The appointment follows the conclusion of the current auditor's second term and remains subject to shareholder approval at the 73rd annual general meeting in 2027.

stories.title: Centric Consulting reports eight industry honors for 2026
stories.summary: Centric Consulting announced eight industry honors for 2026, citing achievements in consulting excellence, workplace culture, technology expertise and individual leadership. The firm says these recognitions reflect the expertise of its people and the culture it has built. Awards are a popular way to measure corporate culture.
